name: rich-input
description: Warp-style Rich Input for Claude Code: the prompt box as a multi-line editor you switch on and off (Enter for a new line, Ctrl+Enter to send), an editor pane for mouse-capable terminals, and @ completion that browses folder by folder

toggleAction.title: Keybinding action that turns rich input on or off
toggleAction.description: Engine action (keybindings.json) whose shortcut presses the '✎ Rich input' button above the prompt. Bind a key to it in the Global context of ~/.claude/keybindings.json.

paneAction.title: Keybinding action that opens the editor pane
paneAction.description: Engine action (keybindings.json) whose shortcut presses the '▤ Editor' button above the prompt. Bind a key to it in the Global context of ~/.claude/keybindings.json.

showBand.title: Show the row above the prompt
showBand.description: Draws the '✎ Rich input: on/off' row above the prompt (required for the keyboard shortcut to work).
